gloss: a row, a line, single file

definitions.gloss: a row, a line, single file
definitions.explanation: A single line of people or things arranged in a row. Used for both horizontal rows and queues.

examples.english: To line up in a single row.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{一列|いちれつ}になって{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: The children walked in single file.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}の{木|き}が{道|みち}に{沿|そ}って{一列|いちれつ}に{植|う}えられている。
examples.english: Cherry trees are planted in a row along the road.

notes:
{一列|いちれつ} means a single row or line of people or objects arranged in sequence.

FORMS:
{一|いち} (one) + {列|れつ} (row, line). The same pattern forms {二列|にれつ} (two rows), {三列|さんれつ} (three rows), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in a single row
- {一列|いちれつ}になって{歩|ある}く: to walk in single file
- {一列|いちれつ}になる: to form a single line
- {一列|いちれつ}{縦隊|じゅうたい}: single-file column (military/formal)

USAGE:
Common in instructions at schools, events, and public spaces. {一列|いちれつ}に{並|なら}んでください (please line up in a single row) is a standard phrase.

RELATED WORDS:
- {列|れつ}: row, line, queue
- {行列|ぎょうれつ}: queue, procession
- {整列|せいれつ}: lining up in an orderly fashion
